mentions.name: aliaskit.com
mentions.description: This SDK lets developers deploy digital identities for AI agents with a click, bundling the phone, email, and payment card setup that would otherwise be configured manually. It ships a TypeScript SDK with plugins (more ready to launch) and includes DID and verifiable credentials documentation for how agents verify themselves, targeting agent-to-agent interactions.
mentions.problem: Setting up the phone, email, card, and other credentials needed to run AI agents like openclaw/hermes/Claude Code is a headache
mentions.audience: Setting up the phone, email, card, and other credentials needed to run AI agents like openclaw/hermes/Claude Code is a headache
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building aliaskit.com. If you ever tried to use openclaw/hermes/Claude Code or any agent for that matter, you'd know setting up the phone and email and card and everything in between is a headache. Our SDK packages it all into one so you can deploy digital identities with a click.
